newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 50,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, a spokesman said on Thursday.
He said an international call had been issued, setting September 17 as the final date to receive price offers. Confirmation would be made on September 18.
The amount would be ready for shipment from October 15 to November 14, he added.
The GCEPT spokesman said the 50,000 tonne offer was separate from the offer announced on September 11 of 100,000 tonnes.
